phase1_leaf_result.part108_scope: Bounded official-GitHub audit of immutable releases as a service-side anti-rollback witness coupled to Contents-CAS publication.
phase1_leaf_result.new_positive: GitHub explicitly documents that an immutable release tag is locked to a specific commit and, after release deletion, its tag name still cannot be reused; the non-reuse guarantee also survives repository delete/recreate. This is a stronger anti-ABA primitive than movable pull-request hidden refs.
phase1_leaf_result.new_falsification: The safe ordering is release-first then Contents-CAS; CAS-first can publish a generation without a witness. Release-first can leave orphan burned tags after CAS conflict, and the retrieved docs do not provide a dedicated tombstone lookup/exact deleted-tag reuse error or explicit post-disable persistence semantics.
phase1_leaf_result.minimal_unresolved_child: Machine-checkable reconciliation for a deleted immutable transition tag or a separately durable automatically generated release attestation, with documented quota-zero and post-delete/disable semantics.

phase1_acceptance.scope_guard: Only retrieved official GitHub immutable-release, release-management, repository REST and release quota documentation plus a bounded release-first/CAS trace model; no repository release/tag/settings mutation was performed.

continuation: Part109: execute one bounded official-GitHub public-source leaf on the automatic release attestation generated for immutable releases. Audit whether the attestation is independently addressable/verifiable after release deletion or repository delete/recreate, whether its subject identity includes immutable tag plus commit SHA and a service-stable identifier, whether attestation retention/discoverability has any finite monthly/trial/paid quota or paid-plan dependency, and whether it closes Part108's deleted-release tombstone reconciliation gap without a second authoritative write. If retention or post-deletion lookup is not documented, fail closed and persist the next service-side witness candidate without executing it in the same invocation.
